cockroachdb.//_mode: Managed MCP defaults to read-only mode with full audit logging.
cockroachdb.//_usage: During development we use this to let Claude Code inspect the live sentinel database directly -- e.g. 'show me the 5 most recent incidents and their embeddings distance from each other' -- without writing any custom proxy code, and with every query audit-logged by CockroachDB Cloud.
